summary: x_read, linkedin_read and instagram_read now consult the link-owner registry too (design/social-per-network/30-link-owner-registry.md, PR 3): a link belonging to another registered network is redirected to the right tool instead of getting each owner's own hand-written "I can't read that" answer, and every such redirect is nothing_found, replacing the unavailable each owner used to answer for the same meaning.
details: instagram_read named no other network before this change; x_read never pointed to linkedin_read. All three now name the right tool and its link parameter.

A link no registered owner claims still gets that tool's own existing refusal, unchanged, and an owner's own unreadable mobile link (m.instagram.com to instagram_read, m.linkedin.com to linkedin_read) is not redirected to itself.
web_fetch and media_fetch are unchanged: same-network links, and everything about the two fetchers, read exactly as before.
